\texttt{WRCR PTCR with changed root\_\allowbreak{}page} & invalidate all current untagged entries when AE is zero; when AE is one software must invalidate the ASID before rebinding it & preserve only mappings whose complete leaf attributes are identical in every context\\
\texttt{WRCR PTCR with changed LA57 or PABITS\_\allowbreak{}SEL} & invalidate entries using the old translation geometry & invalidate entries using the old translation geometry\\
\texttt{WRCR ASCR changing ASID while AE remains one} & select the new ASID-tagged entries & preserve\\
\texttt{WRCR ASCR changing AE} & invalidate the old untagged context or select the new tagged context as applicable & preserve\\
\texttt{SWPT} & install PTCR and invalidate the current untagged context & preserve only identical global mappings\\
\texttt{SWPTA} & install PTCR and ASCR and select the new ASID-tagged context & preserve only identical global mappings\\
\texttt{INVPAGE} & invalidate the addressed page for the current ASID, or the current untagged context when AE is zero & invalidate the addressed global page\\
\texttt{INVASID} & invalidate every entry tagged with the selected ASID & preserve\\
\texttt{INVTLB} & invalidate every local entry & invalidate every local entry\\
